description:
> *Follow-up from defk-uw9 (agent report, 2026-10-12).*

defk-uw9 made a `for` rejected as for-collect report the errors in its body. The cold test kernel (docs/cold-tests/hexdocs-entropy/attempt1.ex.txt) still hides four errors until a second compile:
- Map.update: inside `for ..., reduce: %{}`, whose init is rejected (unsupported-map), so the reduce body is never lowered.
- Map.values, Enum.reduce and :math.log2: inside a `|>` pipe, which is rejected as one error (pipe) and not looked into.

Option: recovery in those two constructs as in recover_for/4 (lower the reduce body with the accumulator poisoned; check each call of a pipe as if it were written nested), suppressing anything that only follows from the rejection.

comments.text: PR #22 opened: recover_pipe/2 and recover_reduce/5 report the errors inside a rejected pipe and a for-reduce with a rejected init or generator; the cold kernel reports 7 errors instead of 4. mix ci green. Ticket stays in progress until the owner merges.

title: Report errors inside a rejected pipe and a reduce with a rejected init
